# KTVZ

> KTVZ is Central Oregon's premier local news station delivering breaking news, live broadcasts, and comprehensive regional coverage through digital and streaming platforms.

KTVZ serves Central Oregon communities including Bend, Redmond, and surrounding areas with local news, weather, and live event streaming. The station operates multiple content initiatives including the Oregon Capital Chronicle for state politics coverage and the Oregon Journalism Project for regional reporting.
